test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 9(1)/(2) years at the rate of 5.9% per annum is ₹6,726. What will be the amount payable on the same sum at the rate of 5.6% per annum simple interest in 3(1)/(7) years?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total interest percentage for first case = 5.9 × 9.5 = 56.05%

Given, 56.05% of **sum** = ₹6,726 ⇒ 1% of **sum** = 6726 ÷ 56.05 = 120

Interest percentage for second case = 5.6 × (22/7) = 0.8 × 22 = 17.6%

Required **amount payable** = 100% (Principal) + 17.6% (Interest) = 117.6%

Value = 120 × 117.6 = ₹14,112

**∴ The correct answer is ₹14,112.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Case 1: **Simple interest** (SI₁) = ₹6,726, **Rate** (R₁) = 5.9%, **Time** (T₁) = 19/2 = 9.5 years

Case 2: **Rate** (R₂) = 5.6%, **Time** (T₂) = 22/7 years

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) / 100 | Amount (A) = Principal (P) + SI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff4abedec3fa4714ac18850d26aeaa097b8f7131fbcabc76044f60bb6e954b10.png] 

⇒ SI₁ = (P × 5.9 × 9.5) / 100

⇒ 6726 = (P × 56.05) / 100

⇒ P = (6726 × 100) ÷ 56.05 = ₹12,000

⇒ SI₂ = (12000 × 5.6 × 22/7) ÷ 100

⇒ SI₂ = 120 × 0.8 × 22 = ₹2,112

⇒ **Amount payable** = P + SI₂ = 12000 + 2112 = ₹14,112

**∴ The correct answer is ₹14,112.**

**__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Concepts

The **principal** remains constant throughout the period. SI is calculated only on the initial **sum** invested or borrowed.

Effective Rate of Interest

The net interest percentage over **time** T at **rate** R is (R × T)%. If the **sum** is constant, SI is directly proportional to (R × T).

Amount Payable

Total **amount** A = P(1 + RT/100). For simple interest, the **amount** increases linearly with **time**.
